## GET /v1/ikea/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns IKEA US products for a keyword search in IKEA's own order, 24 a page for up to 100 pages: the product id (`product.id`), the name with its type and colour, the product link, images, the current price in US dollars with the price before a reduction when the item is reduced, and the star rating with its ratings count. `product.ext.ikea` adds the article number, the size variant IKEA names on some items, the category path and the discount in percent. On rare deep pages and during an outage of the first source a further source serves the same rows without the pre-reduction price, size variant, category and discount. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare IKEA prices, spot reductions or collect products and ratings for a category.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 24/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/24) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Product keywords, 1 to 200 characters, for example desk chair. · e.g. `desk chair`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number from 1 to 100. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls, reviews_count}; `product.ext` {ikea}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/ikea/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=desk chair" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/ikea/product` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
